# Vendored third-party code

`metric.py` is **not** part of this project's own code.
It is the official evaluation metric of the Kaggle competition
[Squares in Squares](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/squares-in-squares),
copied unmodified from the competition's metric notebook
(https://www.kaggle.com/code/metric/squares-in-squares).
